description: Renders one frame per scene of the film as it is now and shows the person a review card: each scene's frame, time and words, with quick notes to tap or type per scene and for the whole film, and where to remember them (this video, the series, all their videos). Stage "draft" when it's ready to watch, in choose each step (its Export, sent, is their OK to export); stage "first-look" (the direction, before polishing) only when they asked to see one. In make it for me, none unless they ask. Their notes come back as one chat message; fix only the scenes they name.
